name: Gemma 2 2B
attention_variant: GQA + logit softcapping (attn 50.0, final 30.0) + sliding-window (4096, 5:1 local:global)
notes: Two serving-relevant mechanisms in one config, both ignored by most quick specs. (1) attn_logit_softcapping 50.0 and final_logit_softcapping 30.0: attention logits and output logits are tanh-clamped. This is numerically load-bearing for stability, and kernels that skip the tanh clamp silently diverge from the reference. (2) sliding_window 4096 with a 5:1 local-to-global alternating pattern — every 6th layer is full-attention over the whole 8192 context. head_dim = 256 is stated explicitly in config.json (it is NOT hidden_size/num_heads = 2304/8 = 288), and that oversized head_dim is the whole point of the GQA design here. kv_cache_bytes_per_token = num_layers * num_kv_heads * head_dim * 2 * 2 = 26 * 4 * 256 * 2 * 2 = 106496 bytes/token at bf16. That is 40x Phi-3 mini's 24576 bytes/token on a model with two-thirds the parameters — a 128k-context claim on a Gemma-2-class KV shape would be 12.7 GiB per sequence at the math above, which is why the sliding window matters so much in practice. query_pre_attn_scalar 256 scales queries before the dot product, compensating for the large head_dim. config.json was read from the unsloth/gemma-2-2b mirror because google/gemma-2-2b is license-gated (HTTP 401 unauthenticated); params_b = 2.614 is confirmed against the gated repo's own safetensors metadata (2614341888), so the mirror is faithful. ONNX community ports exist.
